_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P0 operational targets.

requirements.description: An individual user gets an isolated, identity-scoped workspace whose native tasks, events, and settings survive service and browser restart; a second identity cannot read them (plan REQ-01/REQ-21, INV-01).
requirements.title: Private persistent workspace

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:PLAN-P0-001] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: Civil dates, instants, named timezones, DST transitions, all-day boundaries, and recurrence identity are stored as distinct concepts and never collapsed into one field (plan REQ-05, INV-03; RFC 5545).
requirements.title: Correct time semantics

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:PLAN-P0-002] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: Fixed events, flexible timed sessions, date-assigned effort, and an unscheduled backlog coexist; splitting or moving an allocation conserves demand rather than cloning it (plan REQ-03/D02, INV-07).
requirements.title: Hybrid planning without double-counting

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:PLAN-P0-003] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: Capacity is both a budget and a set of intervals: overlapping busy events subtract their union, reserves count once, unknown estimates are listed separately, and no unqualified 'everything fits' claim is made (plan REQ-09, fixtures F01-F03).
requirements.title: Truthful interval-aware capacity

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:PLAN-P0-004] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: A Today view answers 'what can I usefully do now?' with a next-action surface, scoped capacity, and commitment notices — fully usable manually before any automation, provider, or model is configured (plan REQ-01/REQ-23).
requirements.title: Honest Today experience

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:PLAN-P0-005] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: The approved Observatory visual direction ships with coordinated day and night landscapes, Auto/Day/Night controls, truthful time geometry, and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility as a visual release gate (plan REQ-02/REQ-22/D08, §6).
requirements.title: Observatory day/night experience

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:PLAN-P0-006] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: Every mutation flows through one application-command layer behind HTTP/CLI/tools/adapters with actor+workspace from authenticated context, idempotency keys, expected-revision checks, and atomic local writes (plan REQ-21, §20).
requirements.title: One authoritative command surface
